latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Image to Video skill for converting still images into animated video clips.
- Upload JPG, PNG, WEBP, or HEIC images (up to 200MB), describe desired animation, and receive a downloadable 1080p MP4.
- Supports fast, cloud-based processing for content creators and marketers—no animation skills required.
- Session management and token handling automated for anonymous and registered users.
- Accepted user actions: upload, check credit balance, view status, download/export videos, and add effects or BGM via simple prompts.
- Full API error handling with clear user guidance on credits, file types, and session state.
